name: Kai Kara-France

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (64 in height, 69 in reach, Orthodox, born 1993-03-26); flyweight limit 125 lb, made for UFC 317 (Jun 2025). Reach is about 13 cm longer than his height: long arms for his frame.

photo_coverage: Good. Frontal studio headshot, two full-body studio cut-outs (black and white kits), a high-resolution near-frontal cage-side close-up (UFC 305, Aug 2024), a frontal press-conference still (beanie), a right-side profile (UFC 305 weigh-in face-off), a left-side near-profile with the back (UFC 317 face-off, Jun 2025), two fight photos from UFC 317 (his latest fight, Jun 2025) and a clear back view of the back tattoo (UFC 305). No photo from 2026: he has not fought since UFC 317 and announced a break from competition. Only one freely licensed photo exists (a soft 2021 video still); the other Commons file is tagged CC0 but carries an agency watermark, so it is treated as reference-only.

face.shape: Long oval to rectangular face on a fairly narrow head: high forehead, lean flat cheeks and a defined, angular lower face. Face length clearly exceeds width.
face.jaw: Strong and angular for his size: clear jaw angles below the ears and a straight jawline running to the chin; little soft tissue under the jaw.
face.chin: Medium width, squarish-rounded, slightly projecting in both profiles; no clear cleft.
face.cheekbones: Moderately high; cheeks flat to slightly hollow below the cheekbones at fight weight.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate; the brows sit low and close over the eyes, giving a hooded, intense look at rest.
face.forehead: High, broad and smooth, made to look higher by the buzz cut. The hairline is squared off with sharp, barber-edged corners at the temples (no recession visible).

eyes.shape: Almond, slightly narrow and hooded at rest; opened very wide in his pre-fight 'Don't Blink' stare (UFC 305 close-up).
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest MakeHuman iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, nearly horizontal with a slight downward angle over the outer third; short gap between them.
eyebrows.colour: Dark brown (sample #743d30 is skin-tinted; render about #3a2620).

nose.width: Narrow-to-medium bridge widening to a moderately broad, rounded tip
nose.bridge: Straight and fairly high; straight to very slightly convex in the right-side profile
nose.tip: Rounded, slightly bulbous, roughly level (not upturned)
nose.fight_damage: No obvious deviation or flattening at this resolution.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-width mouth; thin upper lip, medium lower lip; held closed, straight and firm at rest. Wide open roar and tongue-out face in fight-night photos.

ears.size: Medium; stand out slightly from the head (upper rims flare a little in the frontal headshot).
ears.cauliflower_ear: None visible on either ear (right ear in the UFC 317 fight photo and UFC 305 face-off, left ear in the UFC 317 face-off).

face.marks_scars: A few small red blemish spots on the forehead and temples in the studio headshot; light stubble shadow; no scars visible at this resolution.

hair.style: Very short buzz cut, slightly longer on top (a few mm to about 1 cm) with a skin/low fade on the sides and back, squared and lined-up hairline, and a shaved hard-part line on the right side above the temple (visible in the right-side photos). Same look in every photo from 2021 to 2025.
hair.colour_note: Dark brown; the very short length lets scalp show through, so the rendered cap should read as a dark-brown shadow over skin rather than a solid colour.
hair.hairline: Straight and squared across a high forehead, with sharp edged corners at the temples; no widow's peak.
hair.avatar_choice: No shipped proxy is short enough: use a scalp texture/buzz shader (dark brown stubble at about 60 percent opacity over skin) instead of short02.

facial_hair.density: light (one- to two-day shadow over the upper lip, chin and jaw); looks clean-shaven at fight night
facial_hair.shape: Natural, no styled beard or moustache.

skin.tone_hex_method: Plain RGB mean of the samples marked in_average (well-lit cheek/forehead patches; specular, shadowed and coloured-light patches excluded); each sample is the mean of the 15th-85th luma-percentile pixels of the patch.
skin.tone_note: Light-medium skin with a warm olive-tan cast. The ESPN studio files are warm and saturated; the press-conference still (#cc8f7a) reads a little more neutral. Tint toward #d99a80 if the render looks too pink.
skin.freckles_marks: Small blemish spots on the forehead; small bruises and scrapes on the shins in the studio cut-outs (training marks, not permanent).

body.build: Lean, wiry-muscular flyweight: compact torso, broad-ish shoulders for 163 cm, long arms, slim but strong legs.
body.body_fat_note: Six-pack and obliques visible in every studio and weigh-in photo; very little fat on the torso.
body.shoulders: Rounded, well-developed deltoids; shoulders noticeably wider than the waist.
body.chest: Flat, defined pectorals, moderately thick for his size.
body.arms: Long for his height (reach 175 cm); lean biceps with a good peak when flexed, ropey forearms with visible veins.
body.legs_calves: Slim, defined quads and moderate calves; legs proportionate.
body.posture: Upright with the chin slightly down; in face-offs he leans in and juts the head forward, eyes wide, tongue out.
body.notable: Long-armed, narrow-waisted shape and the big right-back tattoo are the main body cues.

tattoos.where: Right upper back: from the base of the neck across the right shoulder blade toward the back of the right shoulder, tapering down the right side of the back to about the lower ribs
tattoos.description: Large black-and-grey Polynesian/Maori-style design shaped like a wing or manaia, with koru curls, parallel bands of fine linework and a row of shark-tooth (niho mano) triangles along its lower edge; its top edge shows on the right trapezius and side of the neck.

tattoos.where: Right forearm, outer side, wrist to just below the elbow
tattoos.description: Black Polynesian/Maori-style band and pattern work.

tattoos_note: The back piece is on his RIGHT side (left shoulder blade bare in the UFC 317 face-off); the forearm piece is on the RIGHT forearm (ESPN white-kit cut-out, UFC 317 fight photo). The forearm piece is not visible in the older black-kit cut-out or the Dec 2021 photo, so it is probably from 2022 or later. He often wears a dark green pounamu-style adze pendant on a black cord at weigh-ins (accessory, not a tattoo).

kit.fight_kit_recent: White Venum shorts with a grey tiger-stripe print, black waistband with white UFC logo and 'KARA-FRANCE' down the left leg (ESPN cut-out; same white shorts at UFC 317, Jun 2025).
kit.fight_kit_other: Black Venum shorts with grey/white print and 'KARA-FRANCE' lettering (UFC 305, Aug 2024; older black-kit cut-out).
kit.gloves: Black UFC 4-oz gloves; wrist tape in his corner colour (blue at UFC 317 and UFC 305).

stance_and_guard_observed.from_photos: UFC 317 fight photo: rear (right) glove tight to the right cheek with the elbow down and the forearm vertical over the chin; head upright. Only a few fight frames were available, so leave guard shape to the stance block built from scouting data.

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets are not in assets/embed/mh-manifest.json. His ears stand out slightly from the head; if ear targets are added: ears/l-ear-wing-incr and ears/r-ear-wing-incr about 0.15, no cauliflower shaping.

morphs_unavailable: No target for the barber-squared hairline, the skin fade or the right-side shaved part: do them in the scalp texture. Arm length: reach is 175 cm on a 163 cm frame, so lengthen the arm bones (about +4 percent over the default) rather than using proportions. macro/heightDownM 0.36 uses heightUpM = 2 * (1.626 - 1.785) / 0.875 = -0.364 from research/assets.md; it is an extrapolation below the measured builds, so measure the mesh and nudge until it reads 163 cm.

render_hints.skin_base: young_caucasian_male tinted toward #e49d86 (or middleage_caucasian_male if the young skin looks too smooth)
render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow001 tinted #3a2620, set low and straight
render_hints.hair: buzz-cut scalp texture, no hair proxy

notes: Confidence: high for hair, brows, eye colour, nose length, jaw, build and both tattoos (sides confirmed from several angles); medium for exact morph values and the nose tip, since the best close-up is an exaggerated expression. Watch for: (1) the squared, lined-up hairline on a high forehead and the very short fade are key to recognising him; (2) long straight nose with a rounded tip, low straight brows; (3) lean, angular face, not round; (4) back tattoo on the RIGHT shoulder blade, forearm tattoo on the RIGHT forearm, nothing on the chest; (5) long arms for a 163 cm man; (6) no 2026 photos exist, the newest are from UFC 317 (Jun 2025). Keep descriptions neutral; ethnicity macros stay at neutral defaults as instructed.
